description: Staging invitation emails for publication, cancellation and rescheduling.

preconditions: A meeting with 2 active participants (Chair An, Member Bình), 1 inactive user, and 1 active Guest invitation.
cases.return: No result. Three dispatch rows are staged: one Invitation per active participant and one for the Guest.
cases.log: Each dispatch has the participant's initial delivery key (or the Guest's) as its deduplication key. No in-app notification is staged.

preconditions: A meeting whose roster has the same user twice (two rows) and a participant who delegated their seat.
cases.return: One dispatch for that user; the delegated seat gets none.
